title: herrickia glauca
intro: Herrickia glauca, commonly known as American Ironweed, is a perennial herb native to North America. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Herrickia glauca include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Herrickia glauca include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
